limitations: The theorem covers m >= 3, n >= 6m, and n congruent to 2 modulo 4. It does not determine the remaining congruence classes or n < 6m, and the coefficient 6 is proved sharp only for the antipodal boundary landmark family used here, not among arbitrary three-landmark sets. Originality is to the best of our knowledge and unindexed parallel work remains a residual risk. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: Previously published finding; fresh independent mathematical audit on 2026-10-01 UTC did not validate originality under current published coverage. Original evidence is preserved.
